Commentary.Commentary: Right then. We are back for the fourth and final innings of the First Test. The visitors need 395 runs to win and they have their work cut out for them. The openers for them, Kraigg Brathwaite and John Campbell make their way out into the middle. Mustafizur Rahman to operate with the ball for the the hosts. Here he comes...

West Indies' bowling was not that bad but Bangladesh's lead was such that they were always behind the game. Jomel Warrican picked up three while Rahkeem Cornwall was the pick of the bowlers for the visitors. The seamers disappointed and West Indies have been left with a tough job on their hands. Their first aim would be to bat without any hiccups till Tea. Bangladesh would look to take few wickets before the break. Join us in a while.

Bangldesh's batting was superb! Mominul Haque was the star of the show with a brilliant hundred while Liton Das was excellent as well. They both stitched a magnificent 100-run stand before Das fell in trying to up the ante. Mominul scored some quick runs before he departed and after that, Bangladesh lost wickets in a heap and they declared with a lead of 394.

Bangladesh are on top! You already knew that though. They have played superbly and have gotten a lead of 394. Bangladesh hold all the cards at the moment and they have a lot of time to bowl out the West Indies. West Indies, on the other hand, have a lot of work to do. They already have the task of chasing down the highest score in Bangladesh and it is unlikely that will happen.

Right then! Bangladesh would look for quick runs after Lunch and post a big score. West Indies, on the other hand, would need to keep it tight and not give many runs away and look to take wickets. Join us at 1210 local (0610 GMT) for the second session.

West Indies, on the other hand, need a miracle. They are way behind in the game. The spinners have bowled well but they have not been rewarded with wickets and to be honest, the Bangladeshi batters have played them really well. A win from here for West Indies looks unlikely but they would hope that they can delay it as long as possible and when they come out to bat later, they should play for a draw.

Hello and a warm welcome to the 4th day's play between Bangladesh and West Indies. Just two days left but this game has moved at a fast pace with Bangladesh moving ahead in the game. They are leading by 218 runs and are holding all the cards at the moment. The question on everyone's mind is what target will the hosts set West Indies. The visitors, on the other hand, need a miracle to make a comeback in this game. They are behind the 8-ball in this game and would hope that they can get all the remaining wickets of Bangladesh as quickly as possible. What will happen? Join us in a while.
... Day 4, Session 1 ...

So, Day 3 ends with the game moving steadily. Still, a lot of time left in the game as we don't know who has the upper hand in the game. How will Day 4 unfold? What target will Bangladesh be hoping to set for the West Indies to chase? All answers will unfold on Day 4 when the game begins at  0930 local (0330 GMT). Till then cheers and take care.

For Bangladesh with the ball, it was  Mehidy Hasan who bagged 4 wickets as Nayeem Hasan, Taijul Islam and Mustafizur Rahman bagged a couple each. They were just relentless in the field. Bowling tight lines and lengths and asking a question to the batsmen on every ball.  Though they would be disappointed to have dropped a few chances and some of the chances flew past their fielders. But overall it was the effort of their spinners that handed them the advantage in the game.

Earlier after coming out to bat at 75/2 West Indies began shockingly as they lost Nkrumah Bonner on the first ball of the day. Since that wicket, Kraigg Brathwaite and Kyle Mayers put up a 55-run stand as Brathwaite went past his 20th Test fifty but could not convert it into a ton as he departed owing to an error in judgement. Mayers too followed soon after. Putting Jermaine Blackwood and Joshua Da Silva in a precarious situation. The duo first saw a few overs before Lunch and when they came back after Lunch they started to score freely. As Blackwood went past his fifty and both the batsmen were involved in a 99-run stand. Just at the stroke of Tea, West Indies lost both of them and after Tea when the play resumed they just collapsed. Folding for 259 runs and handing a huge lead of 171 runs to Bangladesh.

West Indies would be happy with the ball as they managed to get 3 quick wickets to keep them in the hunt after a shoddy batting from their lower order handed the advantage back to the hosts. Cornwall's double strike in his first over did not allow Bangladesh to implode and the wicket of Shadman Islam forced the hosts to adopt the defensive way.

Bangladesh would be disappointed with their batting in the second innings as they lost 3 wickets to get themselves under pressure. Though they would also be happy that the lead is well over 200 and when they come out to bat of Day 4 they would look to add some quick runs and look for a target close to 350 for the West Indies to chase.

What an engrossing day of Test match we have had today. The bowlers dominating, then the batsmen fighting it out and amidst all this runs were scored. Bangladesh might be marginally ahead but West Indies are still in the game and they would look to get the pendulum swing in their favour when they come out on Day 4.
Tossed up and outside off, Mominul comes on the front foot and solidly defends it out. With that, it is STUMPS ON DAY 3.
Flat and just outside off, Rahim goes on the back foot and pokes it to deep point for one.
Flat and just outside off, kept out solidly, off the back foot.
Full and around off, Rahim gets down and sweeps it through short fine leg for two. A risky shot there, late in the day from Rahim. Showed all his stumps there.
Fuller and around middle, turned towards mid-wicket and they take a quick single.
Full and around off, Haque comes on the front foot and defends.
Last over before Stumps coming up.
Slightly fuller but wide outside off again. Rahim shoulders arms.
Short again but wide outside off. Left alone.
Shortish and on middle, kept out.
Banged short this time, worked down to fine leg for one.
Back of a length and around off, Rahim rides the bounce and punches it to the right side of the backward point fielder. A run taken.
Full and around off, Rahim punches the drive towards the man at mid off.
Short and wide outside off, cut towards point.
Tossed up and outside off, pushed towards point for one.
Full and around off, kept out.

Appeal for a catch but not out says the umpire. Tossed up and outside off, Rahim comes on the front foot and looks to defend but the ball hits his pad and lobs behind the short leg fielder. The fielder takes the catch but nothing from the umpire. And guess what. Replays later roll in and they show there was bat.
Shortish and around middle, worked on the leg side for one more easy run.
Flatter and around off, poked towards point for one.

Appeal for LBW but there was an inside edge. The appeal dies down quickly. A length ball, this one jags back in. Mominul looks to defend but the ball takes the inside edge and hits on the pad. A muted appeal.
Banged short but this is down the leg side. Mominul lets it be.
Good length and outside off, poked to deep cover for an easy single.
The Bangladeshi physio is out in the middle. Skipper Mominul is getting some attention. Shannon Gabriel is looking uncomfortable as well. We are ready now!
Shortish and on middle, tucked to deep square leg for one.
Short and wide outside off, punched down to deep cover for an easy single.
Banged short but down the leg side. Rahim sits under it.
Full and around off, pushed towards mid on again. Just 1 off Warrican's over.
Flat and around off, punched towards mid on.
Good stop! A fuller ball on middle, Haque flicks it nicely but the backward square leg fielder gets across to his right and stops with a dive.
Full and wide outside off, driven wide of the cover fielder for one.
Floated just outside off, Rahim comes on the front foot to block this time.
Floated outside off, left alone.
Jomel Warrican is on now.
Mushfiqur is off the mark! Short ball outside off, punched down to sweeper cover for a single. End of a successful over from Gabriel.
Dug in short and on middle, Rahim sits under it.
Another boucner! This is on the leg side. Rahim looks to leave it alone. But this helps is elbow guard and goes to leg slip.
Sharp from Shannon again. This one is just outside off, Mushfiqur drops his hands and lets it go to the keeper.
Short and around off and middle, kept out.
Who will come out to bat now? No nightwatchman for Bangladesh with 5.5 overs remaining in the day. Mushfiqur Rahim comes out to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! Gabriel strikes and he is pumped. He gets the reward, the one he deserved so much. Just less than 4 overs in his spell but he just kept coming. Kept bowling it short and troubled the batters. He bangs it short again. It is on middle and leg, Shadman looks to fend it off on the leg side but ends up getting a nick behind. Joshua Da Silva makes no mistake. Shadman's stay in the middle it over. Replays later roll in and they show that it came off the gloves. Bangladesh lead by 204.
Loopy and outside off, Mominul comes on the front foot and bunts it in front of the silly point fielder.
Tossed up and outside off, Mominul goes for the drive. Connects it well but hits the silly point fielder.
Outside off, left alone.
Short again, this one is punched down to sweeper cover for a run by Shadman.
Slightly short and wide outside off, it is slapped through backward point for two.
Floated around off from Cornwall. Shadman comes on the front foot to block.

DRINKS! The session began with West Indies folding up on 259 runs and trailing by 171 runs. Bangladesh came out to bat and were jolted early as Rakheem Cornwall struck twice in his first over to give an early indication to Bangladesh that they are here to fight. Since then, Shadman Islam and Mominul Haque have stitched a good stand to see Bangladesh's charge towards a score which they can feel safe at. An interesting last hour coming up as just 7 over remain and a wicket here could change the scenario a bit.

FOUR! Nicley done! Another short ball, this one is slightly down the leg side. Haque rides the bounce and works it through short fine leg. There is no one in the deep and it races away to the fence. 200 COMES UP OF THE LEAD!
BEATEN! Lovely stiuff from Shannon. He bowls a short of good length ball outside off, Haque looks to push it off the back foot. The ball though does hold its line and goes past the outside edge.
Short and just outside off, punched towards cover.
Back of a length and on middle, tucked on the leg side.
Short and just outside off, Haque lets it be.
Banged short and on middle, tucked towards leg gully.
Flat and around middle, tucked towards mid-wicket for an easy run.
Floated around off, blocked.
Tossed up and outside off, driven towards mid off.
Loopy ball around off, kept out.
FOUR! Flicked nicely! Full and on middle and leg, Haque flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flat and around off, Mominul stays back to block.
Slips way down the leg side. Left alone.
Another sharp delivery from Gabriel. He is running in and is looking in a good rhythm. Bangs it short and just outside off, Shadman looks to defend but at the last moment drags his bat away.
Back of a length again, this time Shadman gets behind the line to defend.

Another shapr bouncer from Gabriel. This time he bowls it around off, Shadman looks to fend it off but it hits his shoulder and lobs at Cornwall at first slip. He dives forward to catch but it doesn't carry. There wasn't any bat though.
Short again but this one is down the leg side. Shadman lets it be.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, tucked through mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up and outside off, eased through the covers for one.
FOUR! WHIPPED! A fuller one from Rakheem. It is on middle and leg, Mominul uses his wrists and whips it through the wide mid-wicket region. It races away to the fence.
Good running! A flatter ball on middle, Mominul flicks it through mid-wicket and picks up two.
Flat and on middle and leg, worked towards the short leg fielder.
Darted outside off, left alone.
Floated around off, a solid front foot block from the skipper.
Sharp bouncer to end the over. Mominul is in tangle. He somehow manages to fend it off towards backward square leg for a run.
Good length and around off, Mominul blocks it solidly off the back foot.
Back of a length ball on middle, tucked through backward square leg for an easy run.
Landed around off on a good length, Shadman blocks.
Fullish and around off, kept out.
Shannon Gabriel to bowl now.
Shortish ball just outside off, punched towards the cover fielder.
On off and middle, a front foot block from the Bangladeshi skipper.
Flat and just outside off, cut well but straight to the point fielder.
Too full and too wide. Haque drives it wide of sweeper cover and takes two.
Floated around off, solidly defended.

A single and Shadman is off the mark on the 29th ball. Floated around middle, Shadman looks to defend but the ball spins in. It takes the inside edge and goes towards the leg side. They cross for one.
Looped up and wide outside off, driven wide of point for one.
Good length and on middle, blocked again.
Good length and around off, a solid front foot block from Shadman.
Shortish in length and around off, Shadman is right behind the line to block.
Good length and around off, kept out nicely. 25 balls and he is yet to open his account.
Good length and on middle, blocked solidly.
Fuller and around off and middle, Mominul flicks it through mid-wicket. Deep square leg chases it down. Three taken.
Around off, Shadman comes on the front foot and bunts it on the off side.
Flat and on middle and leg, kept out.
Shortish and on the pads, clipped down to deep square leg for an easy run by Mominul.
Loopy ball on middle, pushed back to the bowler this time.
Flatter and around off, keeps a touch low. Poked towards point.
Floated around off, pushed in front of covers.
Landed on a length and around off, Shadman is solid in defense again.
Good length and on off, kept out.
Good length and around off, solidly blocked.
Angled in from middle, tucked through square leg for an easy single.
Fullish and around off, pushed towards mid off.
Landed around off on a good length, kept out.
Flatter and spinning in, Shadman goes on the back foot to block.
Floated around off, Shadman comes on the front foot and blocks.
Tossed up and around off, kept out.
Looped up outside off, poked towards point.
On middle, played back to the bowler.
Floated on middle, Mominul looks to defend but the ball takes the inner half and goes to square leg. Haque is up and running.
A solid block again from Shadman. Another length ball just outside off, Shadman comes on the front foot and blocks solidly.
Length delivery around off, blocked.
Good length and on middle, pushed towards mid on.
Gets closer to the off pole on a length, kept out.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Good length ball angled in from around off, Shdman blocks it on the leg side.
Skipper Mominul Haque walks in next.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one goes. Second in the over! Lovely from Cornwall. No need to play at such deliveries but Najmul plays at it and pays the price by throwing his wicket away. Nice loopy delivery outside off, Hossain Shanto prods forward and looks to reach for the ball. He though fails to get to the pitch of the ball as it takes the outside edge and goes to the man at first slip where Jermaine Blackwood takes a sharp catch.
Fuller and outside off, pushed towards the cover region.
Najmul Hossain Shanto is the new man in.

Review Time! Tamim is given out by the on field umpire he reviews it. Lets see what the replays have to say. Flat line as the ball passes the bat confirms the Ultra Edge. Ball Tracker shows Three Reds.

OUT! LBW! THREE REDS! Tamim departs for a duck and Cornwall celebrates. He tosses it up perfectly towards off, Tamim looks to play for the turn as he prods forward to defend. The ball though straighten to hit him on the pads. Rakheem Cornwall appeals and up goes the finger. Tamim takes the review. The replays roll in and there is a flat line on Ultra Edge as the Ball Tracker comes on. Three Reds and Tamim Iqbal fails once again.
On off, driven to covers.
Another floated ball on off, Tamim blocks it out off the front foot.
Tossed up on off, Tamim defends it.
Who will bowl from the other end? Rakheem Cornwall to bowl now.
Low full toss on off, Shadman does well to get bat on ball to push to to the off side.
Length and around off, Shadman defends it off the back foot towards covers.
Full and on off, driven down to mid off. Finally Roach makes Shadman play.
Once again the line is outside off amd Shadman does not have issue to leave it.
Another outside off delivery and Islam does not play at it.
Fuller and outside off, Shadman lifts his bat and lets the ball through to the keeper.
Length and outside off, Shadman makes a leave. Hang on! Roach has overstepped! No Ball called.
